comment: 16QAM: a 4 x 4 square grid, I and Q at -3, -1, +1, +3, listed I outer then Q.
The first map is Gray on each axis, the first two bits on I and the last two on Q (as
rp.symbol.generate("16QAM")); 3GPP's (LTE, NR) interleaves them: b0 the sign of I, b1 the sign of Q (0
positive), b2 and b3 their sizes (0 the inner)
